title: Pawn-pair accumulator cache
hypothesis: Caching PP_3Wide pawn-pair accumulator contributions across NNUE refreshes can reduce repeated pair-feature recomputation while preserving identical evaluation semantics, improving CPU efficiency and potentially time-control strength.
feature: NNUE refresh-cache optimization based on Stockfish PR #7149. It adds a small pawn-keyed cache for PP feature accumulations and incrementally updates the cached entry when pawn structure changes. This does not add new relational features; it accelerates the PP_3Wide features already present in the September 2026 Stockfish baseline.

efficiency_screen.caveat: Five very short depth-8 samples on a hosted runner are noisy and order-sensitive; this result is retained as a caution, not as a definitive efficiency rejection.

promotion_rule: Do not merge from the 400-game screen. Continue with a fresh paired normalized-SPRT confirmation. Promote only if the confirmation provides positive evidence and later validation remains reproducible; otherwise mark no-promotion/rejected and move to another mechanism.
notes: The 400-game screen was mildly positive but inconclusive. The local NPS microbenchmark was negative but too short/noisy to outweigh the strength screen and upstream Fishtest evidence. FAYE-0003 therefore advances to confirmation rather than merge.
